name: brag-motion
description: Turn the project you built into a launch video: real UI, a composed soundtrack, claims checked against your code, a poster and share copy — then point at any frame to change it.

interface.shortDescription: Turn your project into a launch video you can edit by pointing at it.
interface.longDescription: Reads your project, plans a short launch or feature video in the right tone, rebuilds your real UI, composes its own soundtrack, checks every on-screen claim against your code, and delivers the video with a poster and share copy. Then open the studio and point at any frame to change it.
defaultPrompt: Make a 20-second launch video for what I built.
Make a short video for each feature of this app.
